{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column to confirm treatment and control
print("Arm distribution:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the response rates in each arm
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rates by arm:")
print(response_rates)

# Calculate the treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_prop = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_prop = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect = treatment_prop - control_prop

print(f"\nTreatment proportion: {treatment_prop}")
print(f"Control proportion: {control_prop}")
print(f"Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect}")"}
